mapper.select: SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) FROM category ORDER BY id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) id,name,CAST(parent_id AS CHAR) parentId,sort_order sort,enabled,version FROM category ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE category SET name=#{name},parent_id=CAST(#{parentId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS UNSIGNED),sort_order=#{sort},enabled=#{enabled},version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS UNSIGNED) AND version=#{version}
